android.desc: We know the app is unstable for some people and we are working on solving these issues. App will be updated in a week or two. Introducing the Good e-Reader Audiobook Reader that turns any eBook into an audiobook! This is the first Android app in the world that forgoes the standard text to speech engine and employs Amazon Polly, which is what Alexa is built on. It will read all of your e-Books aloud. While you are reading, the text in the eBook is highlighted in real time, so you can follow along or simply listen on your smartphone or tablet. You can side-load in your own EPUB/MOBI/PRC/FB2 books into your device and choose from over 28 different languages. Individual audio books sold by companies like Audible, Kobo and Google are expensive; you will pay on average between $25 to $45 per title. If you like to listen to audiobooks while going to sleep or working out, it can become a very expensive habit. Good e-Reader is different, you can load in any ebook and it will be read aloud by the best voice assistant in the world. Amazon Polly is the premier voice assistant in tech; it is what the Amazon Echo is based on. Polly sounds more natural than SIRI or Google Voice Assistant. Polly is the perfect narration tool for readers who want their books read aloud and don’t want the standard robotic voice that breaks reading immersion. Good e-Reader is the first Android app that employs Polly in this manner. Key Features • Turn any eBook into an audiobook • Immersion Reading: Text is highlighted when the audiobook is playing. • Audio Narration available in over 28 different languages and 12 male & female voices. • Collection Management. • Dynamic Home Screen: Keeps track of all of your ebooks. • Built in file manager to import in your favorite Books or use Dropbox or Google drive. • Supported eBook formats: EPUB, MOBI, PRC, FB2, PDF. • Bright and Vibrant eBook cover art. • Customize the way you read. Enjoy crisp, clear text in the size and style you prefer. Try Night Mode to make reading easier on your eyes before bedtime. • Easy navigation with quick touch actions and a large visual interface. • High quality mp3 sound. • A better reading experience than Moon+ Reader, FBREADER, Aldiko, Cool Reader, AlReader, Nook, or Laputa.
